description: Site admins only (needs an 'admin'-scoped token). Campaign indicator-of-compromise hits: pushes, token uses and repositories that matched a reviewed signature in src/lib/security/campaign-iocs.json (e.g. the Gheist campaign: ci-sync-XXXXXX branches, sync-check.yml, user agent 'gheist'). Filter by signature_id, repository ('owner/name'), since (ISO date); limit (default 50, max 200) / offset. Returns {signatureVersion, signatures, totals, sweep, hits[{id, signatureId, campaign, severity, detectedBy, repository, ref, sha, tokenKind, tokenId, userAgent, evidence, createdAt}]}. Read-only; nothing is revoked.

repository.description: Only hits on this repository, as owner/name

signature_id.description: Only hits of this signature (e.g. gheist-2026-10)

since.description: Only hits at or after this ISO date/time

name: gluecron_security_ioc_hits
